mapper.select: select cc.class_id, cc.term_id, cc.teacher_id, cc.capacity, cc.selected_count, cc.status, cc.class_time, cc.location, c.course_id, c.course_name, c.course_code, c.credit_hours from course_class cc left join course c on cc.course_id = c.course_id where cc.class_id = #{classId} limit 1
mapper.update: update course_class set selected_count = selected_count + 1 where class_id = #{classId} and selected_count < capacity
